items.title: Complete repository MVP reset
items.value: Remove obsolete active authorities and make the CapabilityTree MVP the only current product direction.
acceptance: obsolete fixed-flow documents and validation launchers are outside active paths
current management files contain no Fixed10, stress, soak, or Provider-planning priority
cleanup remains on an isolated non-force branch

items.title: Consolidate the common Block boundary
items.value: Make ComponentSpec, PortSpec, execution context, result, and executor adapter the single reusable capability interface.
acceptance: WorkNode, ProviderJob, and module contracts are adapters rather than competing authorities

items.title: Finish CapabilityTree composition semantics
items.value: Let the high-capability Agent incrementally create and modify a stable composition tree.
acceptance: add, replace, remove, and expand operations
roles remain optional views over capabilities

items.title: Finish Tree-to-DAG compilation
items.value: Compile executable dependencies separately from the human-readable composition tree.

items.title: Create replaceable executor adapters
items.value: Run bounded Blocks through cheap models, local models, APIs, search, scripts, browsers, and deterministic tools.

items.title: Persist project and run state
items.value: Keep long-lived project goals, tree, DAG, node results, artifacts, failures, and checkpoints without replaying full conversation history.

items.title: Prove one real vertical slice
items.value: Complete one real project change using a high-capability Agent, a cheap model/API executor, a deterministic tool, and an external/search capability.

items.title: Implement affected-subgraph repair
items.value: Map failures to the smallest safe node/subgraph and rerun only affected work.

items.title: Build the capability registry
items.value: Allow the Agent to discover capabilities by inputs, outputs, constraints, cost, executor, and observed quality.

items.title: Prove first validated self-growth
items.value: Discover, integrate, test, register, and reuse one previously missing capability.
acceptance: new Block is registered and reused in the original project

items.title: Add project-team views
items.value: Expose PM, Developer, Tester, Researcher, Release, and Marketing as capability bundles over the same kernel.
acceptance: one project may use only the roles it needs

items.title: Add promotion and publishing capabilities
items.value: Extend the project team into content, media, social publishing, feedback, and metrics without creating another pipeline system.
